caption: The drawing shows a symmetrical arrangement centered on a green vase with red outlines. Emerging from the vase are green stems with rounded and elongated leaves, also in green, and several tulip-shaped flowers, each outlined or accented with red. Perched on the stems and leaves are five red birds, positioned two at the top, two at the lower outside edges, and one on the left above the vase. Scattered around the stems and leaves are small four-petaled flowers in red. At the upper right and left corners of the central composition, there are curved green leafy tendrils with small red flowers, while additional red flowers fill empty spaces throughout the background, contributing to the overall balance and completeness of the design. The background of the image is a plain, lightly aged off-white. The whole composition is framed within a rectangular border.
title: Stencilled Wall
